controller.name: Claude Code
controller.note: Layer 1 is always CC: splits tasks, writes specs and acceptance tests, decides, does the final review. CC's own model is chosen in Claude Code, not here.

layers.impl: Implement / review: hard debugging, integration, reviewing the labor layer's work
layers.labor: Labor: clearly specified code, bulk edits, builds, reading material

executors.name: Codex
executors.notes: good at hard debugging, integration and review; low token use

executors.name: Gemini
executors.notes: clearly specified implementations, bulk edits, reading; verbose, uses several times Codex's tokens; the proxy occasionally garbles conversations; fallback_models: used for a run when the default model does not answer the health probe within 20 s (must also be in enabled_models); context_window: model_context_window passed to Codex for proxy models (0 = Codex default)
